scope: knowledge-time consistency, live runtime identity, independent executable-move verification, and supervised reload

defects_repaired.defect: the integrity worker could publish a report generated by an older news-classification runtime while the supervisor accepted it as current
defects_repaired.resolution: publish classification_version and require the exact V154 contract in supervisor freshness checks

defects_repaired.defect: continuous-narrative seal counts used the report cutoff but incident counts could include rows committed after that cutoff
defects_repaired.resolution: bind seals, integrity incidents and gap incidents to the same snapshot generated_utc

defects_repaired.defect: an atomic Windows file replacement could produce a one-cycle empty JSON read
defects_repaired.resolution: use a bounded three-attempt read retry without carrying stale data forward

defects_repaired.defect: the independent census verifier could observe WAL commits made after its verification clock or compare later durable rows with an earlier latest-report snapshot
defects_repaired.resolution: pin a SQLite read transaction, capture latest-report bytes before the transaction, reconstruct the report only through its own knowledge cutoff, and separately validate every durable evidence clock through the pinned verification clock

defects_repaired.defect: latest-report freshness was measured after the expensive independent replay rather than when the immutable bytes were read
defects_repaired.resolution: measure the unchanged 150-second limit at atomic read time

defects_repaired.defect: the supervisor's 240-second startup grace killed a legitimate cold full verifier replay before first publication
defects_repaired.resolution: retain the 180-second steady-state freshness limit and allow a fail-closed 900-second cold-start grace

defects_repaired.defect: project integrity required a slow append-only verifier and a newer live projection to have identical frame counts and treated audit-start as publication freshness
defects_repaired.resolution: publish audit_finished_utc, bound cold duration to 900 seconds, require a verified immutable prefix, allow only a nonnegative live append-only suffix, and read the verifier before the current projection

knowledge_time_regressions: concurrent WAL commits remain outside a pinned read snapshot
durable rows committed after an earlier report cutoff do not rewrite that report
future or malformed durable clocks still fail closed
latest freshness is bound to atomic read time
a current append-only projection may safely lead a verified immutable prefix
